_comment: Copy this file to config.json (setup.ps1 does it for you) and edit. Paths may be absolute (use forward slashes) or relative to the Pursuit folder.
_deadline_help: Optional countdown tile on the Coach tab (visa end, contract end, savings runway...). Set to null to show 'Drafts waiting' instead.
_sheets_help: Sheet names inside the tracker workbook. Only 'log' is required; the others are optional and skipped if missing.
_daily_items_help: Your default daily routine. Only used the very first time (and for 'Restore default items'); after that you edit the list inside the app.
daily_items: Pick 1 target company from the Target Companies sheet
Research the company + find 1-2 LinkedIn contacts
Log it in the Daily Log (same day)
